name: Nakijin (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakijin village emblem in green and yellow: a green lozenge with concave sides enclosing a yellow disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nakijin, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 November 1973.

features.role: Nakijin village emblem — a green lozenge with concave sides enclosing a yellow disc
